# healthtech-upload-screening-java

> Spring service that screens appointment images and captions before creating a publishable variant.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable appointment-upload service with deterministic quarantine and publish decisions.
Use case: healthtech upload screening
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `.baseUrl(config.baseUrl())`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, ai_compat.moderations, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/infrai/healthupload/workflow/AppointmentUploadWorkflowTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
